heading: Wednesday, September 24, 2025
topLine: 2 model releases: Alibaba Qwen3-Max and Meta Code World Model (CWM).

items.headline: Alibaba launches Qwen3-Max at Apsara Conference
items.summary: Qwen3-Max is Alibaba's largest model, with over one trillion parameters, in Instruct and Thinking modes; Alibaba reports 69.6 on SWE-Bench for the Instruct version. It was announced at Apsara Conference 2025 alongside Qwen3-VL and Qwen3-Omni.

items.headline: Meta FAIR releases Code World Model, a 32B research model
items.summary: CWM is a 32B dense open-weight code model mid-trained on Python execution traces and agentic environment trajectories to study world modeling for code, with a 131k-token context. Meta reports 65.8% on SWE-bench Verified with test-time scaling; weights are released under a noncommercial research license.
